title: German Fritters with Minari Slaw
description: Crispy German-style fritters served with a refreshing minari slaw. A perfect snack for any time of the day.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the warm water, yeast, and sugar. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes.
Add the flour, salt, and vegetable oil to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
Once the oil is hot, add the dough in small pieces, about 1 tablespoon each.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown.
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
To make the slaw, combine the minari leaves, grated carrots, and thinly sliced onion in a bowl.
Drizzle the slaw with butter and toss to combine.
Serve the German fritters with the minari slaw on the side.
